donde-vivir-barcelona.html.title: Where Can I Live? · A Barcelona Housing, Commute & Neighbourhood Explorer
donde-vivir-barcelona.html.description: Filter 164 zones — 91 municipalities plus Barcelona broken into its 73 neighbourhoods — by whatever matters to you. Any of 57 measures can become a range filter with its own histogram, and any filter can be left blank on either side so it shows you the number without ruling anyone out: purchase price, rent, mortgage payment, door-to-door commute, distance to the nearest Rodalies or FGC station, fare zone, water price, daytime and night-time noise, density, altitude, schools, food shops, pharmacies, bus stops per km², distance to the nearest health centre, sports facilities, green space, pre-1960 housing, vacant shopfronts, citizen reports to the council, income, unemployment, recorded crime and the region of nationality of its residents. Five 0-100 grades — housing, transport, services, safety, environment — average the percentiles of each area, and you can open any of them to see which indicators it came from; there is deliberately no overall grade, because weighting safety against price is your call. Criteria live in one bar across the top, each active one a chip you can reopen or drop; map, table and scatter are one linked view that all of them govern. Hover a zone and it lights up everywhere, click it for a card with a data-generated summary and percentile bars, pin up to four to compare side by side against the area median. The table is the comparison surface: add any measure as a column and every numeric cell carries its percentile. Commute times are routed over official timetables; drop up to four named points of your own for an estimate. Nothing is invented: where a source stops publishing, the zone goes grey and the page says how many are missing and why.

sp500-rendimientos.html.title: Does the S&P 500 Really Return 10 % a Year?
sp500-rendimientos.html.description: 155 years of monthly data put the claim to the test: every calendar year, every rolling window, lump sum or monthly contributions, inflation stripped out and costs subtracted — next to gold, US housing and world equities. Shiller, FRED, Eurostat and S&P sources, nothing estimated.

invertir-ya-o-esperar.html.title: Invest Now or Wait for the Right Moment?
invertir-ya-o-esperar.html.description: Lump sum versus spreading it over months, waiting for a dip, and a clairvoyant who buys every year at the cheapest month — tested against every month of the S&P 500 since 1934, plus developed-market equities. Waiting cash earns Treasury bills, and the page shows where the rule of thumb fails.

auroras.html.title: Abisko · Cuándo viajar para ver auroras
auroras.html.description: Ventanas orientativas para buscar auroras intensas en Abisko, combinando el historial geomagnético desde 1932, la fase del ciclo solar y la oscuridad. Rangos de dos meses, contexto estacional y límites claros: actividad global no equivale a brillo local ni garantiza el éxito del viaje. Datos de GFZ, Kyoto, SILSO y NOAA.
